svg.aria-label: Flow: the reader asks in the Ask drawer, Ask answers from the article and up to five related notes, a question past the page moves into Neko chat in the same thread, a team member can join, and if chat is down the reader copies the question and opens Discord.
svg.text: Reader asks in the Ask drawer
+ up to 5 related notes, with cites
Neko chat runs on the team's own server
Past the page? It moves into Neko chat
same thread, carries the article and last turns
A person from the team can join
